ai_summary: Advait Energy Transitions Limited (formerly Advait Infratech Limited) has secured a significant domestic turnkey contract worth approximately INR 24.88 Crores from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation Limited (GETCO). This order, for the design, manufacturing, and supply of Emergency Restoration Systems (ERS), is expected to be executed within eight months, materially boosting the company's revenue and order book in its core business segment. No red flags such as related party transactions or promoter interests were identified, indicating a standard course of business transaction.
